title: Son Sınıf
author: Kadriye Macit
description: For Damla and her friends, life in their quiet seaside town revolves around one goal: surviving their final year of high school and preparing for the university entrance exams that will shape their future. But everything changes when Damla’s boyfriend, Arda, suddenly breaks up with her just before summer vacation. Struggling to navigate heartbreak while staying focused on her studies, Damla soon finds the town gripped by fear as a series of shocking murders begins to unfold. As the body count rises, the final-year students take it upon themselves to track the unpredictable killer, who calls himself Mehdi, in a desperate bid to prevent the next tragedy.
